about: Where the Radiant preset in this folder comes from. Its one file, default.radiantConfig, is the default configuration shipped by radiant_fulcrum_workflow 0.3.3, copied verbatim (make_presets.py records it as template_is_vendor_default, template_note 'radiant_fulcrum_workflow 0.3.3 shipped default, copied verbatim'). make_presets.py copies it through and patches only the keys it names in its record (tolerances, threads).

default.radiantConfig.used_for: a Radiant search of Thermo DIA data (--engine radiant; Radiant cannot read Bruker .d)
